title: Services · Kino
description: Provisioned service health dashboard. Current checks are freshness-gated; missing data is unknown. See panel descriptions for scope and limits.

options.content: Playback and acquisition are separate. Grey means missing or stale evidence. A working downloader API does not prove that importing files succeeds.

panels.title: Public access
panels.description: Current external route probe: DNS, TLS, ingress and the configured application path. Results older than 90 seconds or failed exporter scrapes are unknown.

targets.expr: probe_success{job="blackbox",service=~"jellyfin|seerr",layer="edge"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox"}) < 90)

panels.title: Direct services
panels.description: Current direct backend probe. Compare with the edge panel to distinguish ingress failures from backend failures; this is not a full user transaction.

targets.expr: probe_success{job="blackbox",service=~"jellyfin|seerr",layer="core"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox"}) < 90)

panels.title: Public access
panels.description: Current external route probe: DNS, TLS, ingress and the configured application path. Results older than 90 seconds or failed exporter scrapes are unknown.

targets.expr: probe_success{job="blackbox",service=~"sonarr|radarr|prowlarr|bazarr|qbittorrent|nzbget",layer="edge"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox"}) < 90)

panels.title: Direct services
panels.description: Current direct backend probe. Compare with the edge panel to distinguish ingress failures from backend failures; this is not a full user transaction.

targets.expr: probe_success{job="blackbox",service=~"sonarr|radarr|prowlarr|bazarr|qbittorrent|nzbget",layer="core"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox"}) < 90)

panels.title: Playback and request latency
panels.description: Probe duration for Jellyfin and Seerr, separated by direct backend and public route. This does not measure media streaming throughput.

panels.title: Acquisition endpoint latency
panels.description: Probe duration for the Arr applications and download clients. Slow endpoints may remain reachable.

panels.title: Application checks
panels.description: Configured authenticated health and dependency checks. Health is shown only when the collector ran within 10 minutes and node metrics are current.

targets.expr: service_check_success{service=~"jellyfin|seerr|sonarr|radarr|prowlarr|bazarr|qbittorrent|nzbget"} and on (host, service, check, dependency) (time() - service_check_last_run_timestamp_seconds < 600) and on (host) ((up{job="node"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="node"}) < 90)) == 1)

panels.title: Media processes
panels.description: Unit activity helps locate local failures. A running process does not prove successful playback, healthy indexers or working downloads.

panels.title: Arr health issues by severity
panels.description: Counts reported by the Arr health API. Zero is healthy only when explicitly exported from a fresh health API check. Missing health data remains unknown.

targets.expr: arr_health_issues{service=~"sonarr|radarr|prowlarr"} and on (host, service) (max by (host, service) (time() - service_check_last_run_timestamp_seconds{service=~"sonarr|radarr|prowlarr",check="native_health"}) < 600) and on (host) ((up{job="node"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="node"}) < 90)) == 1)

panels.title: Arr queue items by state
panels.description: Queue counts from fresh Arr API checks. Queue size alone is not a failure; use state and dependency checks to interpret stuck work. Missing API data remains unknown.

targets.expr: arr_queue_items{service=~"sonarr|radarr"} and on (host, service) (max by (host, service) (time() - service_check_last_run_timestamp_seconds{service=~"sonarr|radarr",check="queue"}) < 600) and on (host) ((up{job="node"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="node"}) < 90)) == 1)

panels.title: Application check age
panels.description: Age since the last check run. At 10 minutes the current status and associated API measurements are invalidated.

panels.title: Alert rules: pending and firing
panels.description: Prometheus rule state only. Firing alerts can be inhibited, silenced or grouped by Alertmanager; this panel does not confirm that a notification was delivered. No rows means no matching active rule series.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, alertstate, host, service, scope, severity) (ALERTS{alertstate=~"pending|firing",service=~"jellyfin|seerr|sonarr|radarr|prowlarr|bazarr|qbittorrent|nzbget"})

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Non-idle CPU time, averaged across cores. Historical series; gaps stay empty.

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: RAM used as a share of total, using MemAvailable to account for reclaimable cache.

panels.title: CPU waiting for storage
panels.description: Sustained I/O wait helps identify storage pressure while services remain reachable.

panels.title: Media and download filesystems used
panels.description: Root, Kino media/config datasets and the SSD download staging area. Space pressure can block downloads, imports or metadata writes.

panels.title: Media and download space available
panels.description: Bytes available for media and temporary download data. Mountpoints distinguish the ZFS pool from SSD staging.

panels.title: Kino journal diagnostics
panels.description: Optional Loki view of journal messages containing error, warning, failure or fatal. Messages are diagnostic context, not a health verdict. Uses the configured Alloy host and unit labels.
